protocol.role: Exploratory secondary experiment specified before its own execution; separate from the primary agent study
protocol.question: Does bounded experience selection also affect forgetting in a small neural classifier?
protocol.architecture: 2 inputs, 32 tanh hidden units, 4 softmax outputs; 228 trainable parameters
protocol.data: Synthetic four-class Gaussian data, fixed centers at (-1,-1), (-1,1), (1,-1), (1,1), standard deviation 0.35; classes arrive in four sequential blocks of 400 examples each
protocol.test: 1000 independently generated held-out examples per class, seed 90001; balanced test after each block
protocol.training: One SGD update per arriving example, learning rate 0.05; replay methods add four uniformly sampled retained examples to the minibatch before inserting the current example
endpoints: final accuracy on first three classes
protocol.scope: Small synthetic neural continual-learning demonstration; not language modeling, LLM pretraining, or real-world validation
